programs.name: Agent Memory Leaderboard
programs.summary: No verified Agent Memory public result or completed submission.

programs.name: Agent Memory Benchmark
programs.summary: Full upstream native AMB PrecisionMemBench single-turn self-run repeated on all 77 cases: Agent Memory 15/77, BM25 8/77. Evidence independently reviewed; no official leaderboard listing.
programs.coverage: Multiple memory retrieval and answer-quality benchmark modes, with source-accessible provider implementations.
programs.next_step: Submit reproducible upstream provider and candidate result to AMB maintainers after owner approval; apply runtime selectivity improvements separately.
programs.external_method: Operated by Vectorize, which also develops Hindsight. The upstream project owns datasets, provider evaluation and published outcomes; its commercial affiliation is relevant context for independent review.

programs.name: MemoryArena
programs.summary: One physics task executed locally in the native MemoryArena research harness: Agent Memory 0/3, no-memory 0/3, long-context 1/3 subtask progress; no official published result.
programs.coverage: Interdependent, multi-session agent tasks in research environments; task success measures memory contribution beyond retrieval alone.
programs.next_step: Reproduce with adequate judge/model quality and more tasks before asserting outcome comparisons; publication/submission is not verified.
programs.external_method: Research code is explicitly labeled preview; a public Agent Memory submission or official leaderboard listing is not verified.
